title: New data show the object separated from the seabed

tellings.quote: It looks like it's separated from the bottom. That's what I can say.

plain: New 2025 data on a strange object lying on the floor of the Baltic Sea show that it seems to be separated from the seabed beneath it. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, whose team found and surveys the object, says so, putting it carefully: "It looks like it's separated from the bottom. That's what I can say." If true, it would suggest the object is something sitting on the seafloor rather than a natural part of it.
